item.title: FBR collects Rs7,176 billion in seven months of FY2026
item.description: F.P. Report ISLAMABAD: The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has collected Rs7,176 billion during the first seven months of the current fiscal year (FY2026), registering a growth of 10.57 percent compared to Rs6,490 billion collected in the corresponding period of last year, reflecting an improving revenue trajectory amid ongoing economic recovery. item.title: Bitcoin falls below $80,000, continuing decline
item.description: (Reuters) : Bitcoin, the world’s largest cryptocurrency by market value, was down by 6.53 per cent at $78,719.63 at 12:48 p.m. ET (1748 GMT) on Saturday. item.title: US authorities reportedly investigate claims that Meta can read encrypted WhatsApp messages
item.description: US authorities have reportedly investigated claims that Meta can read users’ encrypted chats on the WhatsApp messaging platform, which it owns. The reports follow a lawsuit filed last week, which claimed Meta “can access virtually all of WhatsApp users’ purportedly ‘private’ communications”.
